name: The Bhāgavata's sequence from hearing to seeing the Lord (BhP 1.2.16-21)

stages.name: mahat-sevā, tīrtha-niṣevaṇa
stages.gloss: service of great souls and holy places
stages.description: Serving the great and holy places gives faith and the wish to hear.

stages.name: kathā-ruci
stages.description: A taste for hearing the Lord's stories arises.

stages.name: abhadra-vidhūnana
stages.description: Kṛṣṇa in the heart of the hearer removes impurities.

stages.name: naiṣṭhikī bhakti
stages.description: With impurities almost gone, by service to the Bhāgavata, steady devotion arises.

stages.name: sattve prasāda
stages.description: The mind, untouched by rajas, tamas, lust and greed, rests in sattva and becomes clear.

stages.name: bhagavat-tattva-vijñāna
stages.gloss: knowledge of the reality of Bhagavān
stages.description: To the clear, unattached mind knowledge of the Lord's reality arises.

stages.name: hṛdaya-granthi-bheda
stages.gloss: the knot of the heart cut
stages.description: Seeing the Lord as the self, the heart's knot is cut, doubts severed, karmas exhausted.

name: Keśidhvaja's yoga (VP 6.7)

stages.name: yama
stages.description: celibacy, non-harming, truth, non-stealing, non-possession, practised without desire

stages.name: niyama
stages.description: study, purity, contentment, austerity, mind turned to Brahman

stages.name: āsana
stages.description: a posture such as bhadrāsana

stages.name: prāṇāyāma
stages.description: with a support (sabīja) or without (abīja)

stages.name: pratyāhāra
stages.description: the senses made to follow the mind

stages.name: dhāraṇā on śubhāśraya
stages.description: the mind fixed on Viṣṇu's form, simplified stage by stage until steady in all activities

stages.name: dhyāna
stages.description: one continuous flow of that form, desiring nothing else

stages.name: samādhi
stages.description: grasping the object's own nature free of imagination

stages.name: brahma-prāpti / abheda
stages.description: knowledge leads the self to Brahman and ceases; difference, made by ignorance, is gone

notes: VP 6.7.33 also distinguishes the practiser (yuñjāna) from one of perfected samādhi (liberated in this birth).

name: Kapila's yoga with a support (BhP 3.28)

stages.name: svadharma and restraints
stages.description: own dharma, contentment, service of knowers of self, non-harming, truth etc.

stages.name: āsana-jaya, prāṇa-jaya
stages.description: purifying the breath's path; breath burns faults

stages.name: pratyāhāra
stages.description: the senses drawn into the heart

stages.name: rūpa-dhyāna
stages.description: limb by limb, dwelling on glance and smile

stages.name: bhāva and release of the hook
stages.gloss: love, then letting go of the image
stages.description: melting love; the mind releases even its hook

stages.name: nirvāṇa of the mind
stages.gloss: the mind goes out like a flame
stages.description: free of support and object, the self seen as one without division

stages.name: siddha
stages.description: indifferent to the body, which lives on while karma lasts

notes: Within the Kapila Gītā (U06 owns the Gītā as a source); kept here because the coverage item names BhP 3.28.

name: The heart-lotus meditation taught to Uddhava (BhP 11.14.32-46)

stages.name: sama āsana, breath
stages.gloss: posture, gaze, purification of the breath-channels

stages.name: heart-lotus visualisation
stages.gloss: lotus, sun-moon-fire, the Lord's form in the fire

stages.name: pratyāhāra with buddhi as charioteer
stages.gloss: senses withdrawn, mind led to the Lord

stages.name: one point: the smile
stages.gloss: the whole form gathered to the smiling face

stages.name: space, then nothing
stages.gloss: mind fixed in space, then no thought

stages.name: jyotir jyotiṣi
stages.gloss: the self seen in the Lord, light in light

stages.name: nirvāṇa of the triple delusion
stages.gloss: delusion of object, knowledge, action at rest

name: The yogin's gradual ascent after death (BhP 2.2.22-31)

stages.name: Vaiśvānara
stages.description: purified, he reaches Agni

stages.name: the world of the wise for a kalpa (Maharloka)
Satyaloka (pārameṣṭhya)
stages.description: reached when the universe burns

stages.name: passage through the elements, senses, mind and vijñāna

notes: A post-mortem ascent rather than a stage-map of practice; only the final stage is banded.

stages.name: viveka
stages.gloss: discrimination of self and not-self; cutting 'mine'

stages.name: conduct and vows
stages.gloss: five vows, five observances, begging, the three staffs

stages.name: āsana and prāṇāyāma
stages.gloss: posture, breath, avoiding wrong places and times

stages.name: pratyāhāra and dhāraṇā
stages.gloss: withdrawal; ten bodily places of holding

stages.name: overcoming the upasargas
stages.gloss: turning from rewards and the five states

name: The Vāyavīya's five yogas and the Śaiva path of meditation (ŚiP 7.2.37-39)

stages.name: adhikāra: dispassion
stages.description: dispassion toward seen and scriptural objects

stages.name: mantra-yoga
stages.gloss: mind resting on the mantra's meaning

stages.name: mahā-yoga
stages.gloss: Śiva's own nature alone, without adjuncts

notes: The text also gives the eight (or six) limbs as the general frame, and saviṣaya→nirviṣaya meditation (7.2.39); presenting the five yogas as a sequence is itself an interpretation (the text says only that mahā-yoga is highest).

name: The Liṅga Purāṇa's eight means of yoga (LiP 1.8-9)

stages.name: yama
stages.description: non-harming first

stages.name: overcoming obstacles and upasargas
stages.gloss: renouncing the powers by supreme dispassion
